description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarSync class, which acts as a facade for calendar synchronization functionalities within SuiteCRM. It manages synchronization processes for calendar accounts and meetings, handles configuration, and interacts with various domain services, repositories, and providers. The class implements the CalendarSyncInterface and includes methods for scheduling sync jobs, testing connections, handling events, and managing calendar account data.

classes.name: CalendarSync
classes.description: Main class implementing calendar synchronization interface, providing methods for syncing calendar accounts, meetings, and events, as well as configuration management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Schedules or runs a synchronization of all calendar accounts, either manually or scheduled.

methods.name: syncAllMeetingsOfCalendarAccount
methods.description: Synchronizes all meetings of a specified calendar account.

methods.name: syncMeeting
methods.description: Synchronizes a specific meeting bean, handling creation, update, or deletion actions.

methods.name: getActiveCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all validated calendar accounts associated with a user.

methods.name: hasPersonalCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if a user has a personal calendar account.

methods.name: getPersonalCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves personal calendar accounts for a user.

methods.name: syncEvent
methods.description: Deserializes event data and performs synchronization through the orchestrator.

methods.name: getProviderAuthMethodWithValidation
methods.description: Returns the authentication method for a provider source after validation.

methods.name: testProviderConnectionWithValidation
methods.description: Tests calendar provider connection validity based on an account.

methods.name: findDuplicateCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if a calendar ID is already used by another account.

methods.name: getFieldsToHide
methods.description: Returns the form fields to hide based on the provider's authentication type.

methods.name: getCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Returns available calendar source types from the provider registry.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves configuration settings passed from a form or request.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the scheduler instance responsible for scheduling jobs.
